integrity: Exact projector proof and standard-library exact-rational 2952-case replay. Originality comparisons are bounded by available primary material; one 2015 related full text remained inaccessible. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact for equilateral Kirchhoff metric complete-bipartite graphs with consistent P1 mass and theta in [0,1], p,q>=1, max>=2. Does not extend to heterogeneous edge lengths, other graph families, or mass-lumped schemes.
title: Sharp \(\theta\)-step positivity on complete-bipartite metric networks
